items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I knew Duke when he had five pieces.

ctx.x: He did. Me and him been knowing. You understand the reason I know him? In 1931, I know him. Because when I got Roosevelt Sykes in 1931, Hatchet was the first to have 31 children. I come over there and got Roosevelt Sykes and brought him to Knight Street to Hunter's Place. He had to build one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one by one…

Well see we first did it for OK. Yeah that's OK. Mr. what is his name? The head of that friend. Clarence Williams? No, no, I mean the man ahead of OK. Walker? No, no it wasn't. Mr. If you get by the point of... She had another number, it was a blues, it wasn't a... Do I know that you would have a... Satisfied blues, that's one. That was the thing she did. We had, I had this boy Emmett, but it wasn't Emmett, it was Emmett McKeever. McKeever, you never had that drummer. Yeah, that's my drummer. And I had this boy,…
